items.summary: Approved containment-only updates to existing reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, bounded security-evidence, and private-launch workstreams. Reject new proposals, production changes, queue expansion, requeues, telemetry requests, spending, monetization, and external outreach. Revenue is limited to one day with $0 site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, causal lift, cost-to-learn, and operational health remain unknown.

Owner message: keep the gated product private. The prepared permission request must remain unsent unless the owner authorizes it after human legal review. Rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain incomplete.

Continue measurement only with existing source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI cost. Do not treat missing values as zero or claim financial or causal outcomes.
Continue failure containment without requeue. Require deduplication, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and explicit requeue-or-close evidence before any implementation resumes.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture from authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Preserve unknown controls as unknown; do not access credentials, change permissions or configuration, deploy, or claim certification.
